# FloatJet

> FloatJet helps remote workers find the best tools, gear, and guides for productive work-from-anywhere lifestyles.

## What We Cover
- Remote work tools (VPNs, project management, communication)
- Home office gear (desks, chairs, monitors, laptops)
- Productivity guides and workflows
- Digital nomad resources (visas, banking, travel)
- Freelancer finance (taxes, invoicing, payments)

## Our Expertise
- Hands-on testing of remote work products
- Practical guides from experienced remote workers
- Honest comparisons with clear recommendations
